A_trait: floral longevity; flower number; flower size under pollination and abiotic context
decision_note: Primary Sabatia experiment manipulates pollen deposition and quantifies expressed floral longevity plus trade-offs and seed-predation risk. Pollination and antagonist channels are measured, but they are not closed on one common plant reproductive outcome or one matched trait-response geometry.

A_trait: inflorescence colour; stigma-nectary distance; floral cyanide; structural defence traits
decision_note: Comparative study across 51 Western Australian Hakea species links pollination syndrome to physical and chemical defence architecture. It is evolutionary/comparative outcome evidence rather than a direct matched receiver-response geometry.

A_trait: temporal floral volatile emission after Hadena floral interaction and oviposition
decision_note: Primary Silene study measures temporal VOC suppression/induction after interaction with nursery pollinator Hadena bicruris with and without oviposition. The same moth has coupled roles in the broader system, but this focal source does not measure pollination service or plant reproductive fitness.

Focused synthesis of tissue-level within-flower scent variation across published data plus comparative scent dissections. Valuable source-chasing material but not an independent primary study for the systematic primary-study count.
